title: Web Development Intern
description: Work alongside our platform team to build and ship real features for the VaultofCodes learning dashboard, with weekly code reviews and mentorship.

title: Python Developer
description: Own backend services powering course delivery and assessments for over 40,000 learners. You'll design APIs, optimise queries, and pair with the frontend team.

title: Data Science Intern
description: Analyse learner engagement data to help us personalise course recommendations. Great fit for students comfortable with notebooks and a curious mindset.

title: Product Designer (UI/UX)
description: Shape the visual language of our course platform and career portal, from wireframes to polished, accessible interfaces used by thousands of students daily.

title: Technical Content Writer Intern
description: Write beginner-friendly tutorials and course guides that help thousands of students get unstuck. Ideal for strong writers who enjoy explaining code.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Keep our learning infrastructure fast and reliable during live cohorts and traffic spikes, and build the pipelines that let us ship safely every week.

title: Campus Ambassador
description: Represent VaultofCodes on your campus, run workshops, and build a student tech community, with certificates, stipends, and referral rewards.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description: Build and maintain the automated test suites that keep our course platform reliable through every release.

title: Mobile App Development Intern
description: Help us build native-feeling mobile learning experiences for students who study on the go.

title: Growth Marketing Associate
description: Run acquisition campaigns across channels to help more students discover VaultofCodes courses, and turn data into decisions every week.
